processScope: one ordinary native CLI process per batch; no persistent session or concurrency
consumer: two bounded in-memory pipe drains; post-timing private capture writes; no terminal/slow-consumer measurement
clock: time.perf_counter_ns before Popen through exit and both bounded drains; capture writes/validation excluded; overhead not subtracted
cache: fresh per batch; all eight source hashes before/after each round warm-expose uncontrolled OS cache; device/server uncontrolled or unknown; no cache eviction
stopping: fixed schedule; no adaptive stop/retry/outlier trimming; failed/censored slots retained
statistics: size-separated success-conditional distributions, noise across rounds and failure/censor counts; whole-batch/N is amortized cost, not per-file latency
disclosure: All actual camera-derived measurements/results/reports remain private; current private-analysis grant denies publishReports. No camera-derived statistics or fixture-specific identities appear in this method record.
